title: fix(plugin-audit): sys_audit_log describes the guarantee it has, not immutability
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9FFj6TzeAiJ5p8ombt45AFw)_
Fixes #31909

Clause-②: no — only a description string, its translations, a README sentence and code comments change; the object's fields, permissions and API behaviour are byte-identical (plugin-audit suite 1259/1259 on the head).
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:审计日志对象 `sys_audit_log` 的说明（Setup 和元数据读取都会显示）从「不可变的审计追踪」改成实测到的保证：记录只由平台写入，在数据 API 和设置中只读。英文原文、10 个译文、包 README 和三处代码注释用同一说法。
- 为什么改:cloud#4016 实测，系统上下文的写入、到期删除和脱敏迁移仍能改删这些行且不留痕迹，「不可变」是一句错话;docs.objectos.ai 和安全问卷（cloud#4029）已改，框架自己的说明还没改。
- 风险与回滚：只改文案，行为不变;回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/objects/sys-audit-log.object.ts`(文档注释与 `description`),`packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/translations/zh-CN.objects.generated.ts`。
- 两分钟验证:`git grep -niE "immutab|tamper-?proof" -- packages/plugins/plugin-audit` 没有任何输出（main 上有 7 处命中）。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- `sys-audit-log.object.ts`: the doc comment and `description` stop saying "Immutable". The description now reads *"Audit trail of platform events. Rows are written only by the platform and are read-only through the data API and in Setup."* The doc comment says the same and adds what does not hold: platform code running in a system context (retention archive-then-delete, redaction migrations) can still change or delete rows, and nothing records that it did. No tamper-evidence is claimed (that is cloud#4016 ruling (c), a separate card).
- `translations/en.objects.generated.ts`: regenerated with `node scripts/check-i18n-bundles.mjs --filter=audit --write`; the only change is the `description` leaf.
- The ten translated locales (`ar`, `de`, `es-ES`, `fr`, `ja-JP`, `ko`, `pt-BR`, `ru`, `zh-CN`, `zh-Hant`): each held its own "immutable" rendering of the old description. Merge-mode extraction never rewrites a translated leaf, and no source-hash entry exists for this path (legacy-trusted, never reported stale), so each leaf is re-translated by hand. The word used for Setup in each locale follows the one the plugin-security bundle already uses. Only that one leaf per file changes.
- `README.md` (ships in the npm package), `src/index.ts` and two comments in `src/audit-writers.ts` called the ledger immutable too; they now use the same wording or drop the adjective. These four were added to the claim's file surface by the seat.
- `.changeset/31909-audit-log-not-immutable.md`: `@objectstack/plugin-audit` patch.

## Tests

No test or snapshot pinned the old string: `git grep -n "Immutable audit trail"` on `origin/main` (489f0cea) hits only the object file (twice) and the generated `en` bundle. No test is added for a sentence of copy.

CONTROL: the full plugin-audit suite on head `101113a1`, under the verification lock:

```
pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-audit test      VERDICT command-exit 0 · Test Files 81 passed (81) · Tests 1259 passed (1259)
pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-audit typecheck VERDICT command-exit 0
eslint (packages/plugins/plugin-audit)            exit 0
```

</details>

Ablation does not apply: the diff changes no behaviour and adds no negative pin; it changes copy and comments only.

## Acceptance notes

- `content/docs/data-modeling/objects.mdx:275` describes the `append-only` managedBy bucket as "Immutable audit trail — View + Export only." That row describes the bucket, which `sys_activity`, `sys_email` and `sys_metadata_audit` also use, not this object, so it is left alone here. carrier: none.
- `content/docs/deployment/production-readiness.mdx:251` says the runtime has no built-in audit-log immutability layer. That is accurate and unchanged.
